title: BPSC TRE 3.0 PGT Computer Science (2024 Official PYP Mock)

questions.question: Who led the Revolt of 1857 in Bihar?
questions.explanation: Veer Kunwar Singh of Jagdishpur led the 1857 Indian rebellion in Bihar.

questions.question: Which data structure follows the Last-In, First-Out (LIFO) principle?
questions.explanation: A Stack operates on LIFO order where elements inserted last are popped first.

questions.question: Which SQL statement is used to remove a table structure permanently along with all its data?
questions.explanation: DROP TABLE deletes both table schema and data rows permanently.

questions.question: What is the time complexity of searching an element in a balanced Binary Search Tree (BST)?
questions.explanation: In a balanced BST, tree height is log2(N), giving O(log N) search time.

questions.question: Which protocol is responsible for assigning automatic IP addresses to client devices in a network?
questions.explanation: DHCP (Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol) automatically assigns IP addresses and network parameters.
